description:
Deliverable: docs/architecture/P14_PREDICTION.md with a data-flow diagram.
Acceptance criteria: (1) market data ingestion, forecasting engine, Kelly-capped sizing, and order lifecycle each map to a module; (2) the wallet-isolation boundary is drawn and the polyclaw_wallet_only rule is stated as fail-closed; (3) kelly_cap and polyclaw_wallet_only gate semantics are defined numerically.
Constraints: live path is the Polyclaw wallet only, never the treasury; live_blocked=false.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Prediction-market architecture spec with wallet-isolation boundary

description:
Deliverable: IMarketDataFeed, IForecastEngine, IKellySizer, IPolyclawWalletAdapter with typed signatures in src/sincor2/agents/p14_prediction/api.py.
Acceptance criteria: (1) every spec flow (ingest, forecast, size, execute, settle) maps to an interface function; (2) mypy passes on the module with zero errors; (3) no strategy type reaches the signing boundary.
Constraints: wallet interface exposes no treasury-key path.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Typed Python interfaces for feed, forecast, sizer, wallet

description:
Deliverable: economics model document with the Kelly fraction table and fee-accrual formula.
Acceptance criteria: (1) sizing model with the quarter-Kelly (0.25) fraction table validated against scripted trade histories; (2) 15 bps protocol fee on settled PnL traces to Treasury 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac; (3) 16% expected APR derivation shown with assumptions.
Constraints: max allocation 10% of bankroll per position; fee on settled PnL, not notional.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Economics model: 15 bps fee on settled PnL, Kelly fraction table

description:
Deliverable: src/sincor2/agents/p14_prediction/, config/agents/, tests/pytest/test_p14_*.py stubs, scripts/deploy_p14.py stub.
Acceptance criteria: (1) directories exist and import paths resolve; (2) pytest collects stubs with zero errors; (3) py-clob-client pinned in requirements (it was missing from requirements.lock).
Constraints: layout matches the api.py module map.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Create P14 repo layout and test stubs

description:
Deliverable: working boilerplate classes with error handling and TOA hook stubs; config/agents/p14-prediction.yaml with dry_run=true and polyclaw_wallet_only=true.
Acceptance criteria: (1) agent imports cleanly and boots in dry-run from the YAML; (2) CI picks up the new test files; (3) no stub can sign or broadcast.
Constraints: dry_run=true is the default; live requires explicit config change.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Agent boilerplate: feed/forecast/sizer/wallet stubs with dry-run default

description:
Deliverable: src/sincor2/agents/p14_prediction/forecast.py consuming market prices and event metadata.
Acceptance criteria: (1) outputs calibrated win probabilities with confidence intervals; (2) engine beats the naive baseline Brier score on scripted historical markets; (3) calibration history persisted per market category.
Constraints: any category with Brier > 0.25 triggers recalibration, not more capital.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Probability forecasting engine with Brier-score calibration tracking

description:
Deliverable: the ONLY live execution path - signs and submits orders exclusively through the Polyclaw wallet.
Acceptance criteria: (1) fail-closed check on every call hard-blocks any treasury-key usage attempt; (2) red-team test attempting treasury-key usage: 100% of attempts blocked and logged; (3) dry-run orders execute end-to-end with wallet state isolated from strategy logic.
Constraints: minimal code in the adapter; no strategy logic inside the signing boundary.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Polyclaw-wallet-only execution adapter with treasury-key red-team test

description:
Deliverable: Kelly sizer converting forecast edge into a capped stake.
Acceptance criteria: (1) f_deployed = f* x 0.25 x confidence^2, hard-clamped to 10% of bankroll; (2) unit tests prove stakes never exceed the Kelly cap across randomized edges; (3) cap binding triggers a logged warning.
Constraints: kelly_cap gate; full Kelly never deployed.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Kelly-capped position sizer: quarter-Kelly times confidence squared

description:
Deliverable: feed fetching order books, market metadata, and resolution sources with retries and rate-limit handling.
Acceptance criteria: (1) pulls live-format data from stubbed endpoints and survives injected failures; (2) data older than 60s is marked unusable for sizing; (3) markets below $10k 24h volume or without a resolvable oracle are excluded.
Constraints: resolution via UMA optimistic oracle (~2h dispute window) or Chainlink Data Streams for short-duration markets.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Polymarket/OpenClaw market-data integration with staleness guard

description:
Deliverable: lifecycle manager opening positions via the wallet adapter and tracking them to resolution.
Acceptance criteria: (1) scripted market lifecycle (open, resolve, redeem) completes in dry-run; (2) expected vs realized PnL reconciles to the cent; (3) near-resolution entry blocking and force-review work.
Constraints: GTC maker orders preferred (0% fee markets); FOK for exits.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Order lifecycle manager: open, track, resolve, redeem, reconcile

description:
Deliverable: per-market loss limit, daily loss circuit breaker, 10% max_alloc_pct enforcement.
Acceptance criteria: (1) breaching any limit halts new orders with a named alert; (2) daily breaker at 5% of bankroll resets only via the documented manual procedure, never automatically; (3) portfolio cap 60% deployed and category cap 40% enforced.
Constraints: per-market loss limit 3% of bankroll; max 90 days to resolution.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Risk limits and daily circuit breaker with manual reset

description:
Deliverable: fee routing to Treasury 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac recorded in a fee ledger.
Acceptance criteria: (1) fee math unit-checked against scripted settlements; (2) ledger reconciles to the treasury-bound total to the cent; (3) per-trade attribution present for every fee entry.
Constraints: 15 bps on settled PnL only; losing trades accrue no fee.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Route 15 bps of settled PnL to Treasury with per-trade attribution

description:
Deliverable: tests/pytest/test_p14_units.py.
Acceptance criteria: (1) all tests pass and the suite runs in CI; (2) forecast calibration math checked against known Brier values; (3) Kelly cap enforcement and fee ledger math covered.
Constraints: suite runs under 5 minutes in CI.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Unit tests for forecast calibration, Kelly cap, fee ledger

description:
Deliverable: tests/pytest/test_p14_integration.py.
Acceptance criteria: (1) end-to-end pass: ingest stubbed data, forecast, size, execute via the Polyclaw adapter in dry-run, resolve, redeem; (2) PnL assertions hold; (3) red-team case proves treasury keys are never touched.
Constraints: all external calls stubbed; deterministic fixtures.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Integration tests for the full trade lifecycle in dry-run

description:
Deliverable: property/fuzz tests over randomized forecasts and market sequences.
Acceptance criteria: (1) stakes never exceed the Kelly cap under randomized forecasts; (2) losses never exceed the daily breaker; (3) the fee ledger always balances; zero property violations on a full run.
Constraints: seed corpus checked in for reproducibility.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Property and fuzz tests: Kelly cap, breaker, ledger balance

description:
Deliverable: scripts/sim_p14_backtest.py replaying scripted historical market data.
Acceptance criteria: (1) runs green end-to-end; (2) realized PnL, max drawdown, Brier score, and fee totals logged per market; (3) walk-forward split used - in-sample-only tuning rejected.
Constraints: backtest must be green before any live discussion.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Historical backtest simulation with PnL, drawdown, Brier, fees

description:
Deliverable: audits/p14/ with frozen code hash, threat model, wallet-isolation proof, findings tracker.
Acceptance criteria: (1) threat model covers oracle/resolution manipulation, wallet key compromise, Kelly overbet from miscalibration; (2) the Polyclaw-only live path formally documented and evidenced; (3) findings tracker initialized.
Constraints: code hash frozen and recorded.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Audit-prep package with wallet-isolation proof

description:
Deliverable: fixes for all findings with regression tests per finding.
Acceptance criteria: (1) findings tracker shows every item closed with a linked test; (2) full suite passes on the remediated tree; (3) threat model updated for each fixed class.
Constraints: no fix weakens the wallet isolation boundary.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Remediate audit findings with regression tests

description:
Deliverable: optimized hot paths plus a before/after benchmark report.
Acceptance criteria: (1) measurable latency reduction on the decision loop; (2) identical outputs on the regression corpus; (3) forecast inference, feed polling, and sizing each benchmarked.
Constraints: no behavioral change; sizing math bit-identical.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Optimize decision-loop performance: inference, polling, sizing

description:
Deliverable: docs/p14/ with system overview, forecasting methodology, Kelly sizing reference, wallet-isolation design.
Acceptance criteria: (1) docs build without warnings; (2) sizing formulas fully specified with worked examples; (3) a new builder can operate the agent from docs alone.
Constraints: numeric parameters table matches the spec.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Technical documentation: system, methodology, sizing, wallet isolation

description:
Deliverable: config/agents/p14-prediction.yaml and docs/ops/P14_RUNBOOK.md.
Acceptance criteria: (1) agent boots from the YAML in dry-run; (2) YAML holds Kelly fraction 0.25, loss limits, market allowlist, TOA hooks; (3) runbook breaker procedure matches the implemented circuit breaker.
Constraints: dry_run=true default; wallet credentials path never in repo.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Agent YAML config and ops runbook with breaker procedure

description:
Deliverable: structured JSON logs for forecasts, positions, PnL, drawdown, breaker state, fee accrual.
Acceptance criteria: (1) dry-run emits sample payloads validating against the feed schema; (2) feed reports real values or 'unknown', never fabricated 'healthy'; (3) Brier score per category exposed.
Constraints: staleness > 60s marks values unknown.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Dashboard and monitoring hooks in the SINCOR feed format

description:
Deliverable: scripts/deploy_p14.py installing the agent service, wiring the wallet credentials path, configuring the dashboard feed.
Acceptance criteria: (1) dry-run deploy succeeds in a container; (2) script is idempotent; (3) wallet credentials path never in the repo.
Constraints: staging only; no live capital.
Reference: per specs/p14-prediction-markets.md §Acceptance criteria.
title: Staging deploy scripts for the P14 agent

description:

Acceptance criteria: (1) every item marked pass/blocked with an owner; (2) covers audit sign-off, backtest green, wallet-isolation re-verified, live capital limits, key-management plan, rollback procedure, TOA revenue gate; (3) no live capital without audit sign-off and founder approval.
